guide_line: Read the group, the period, the block, and the valence count from the table.
steps: The table lines the elements up by atomic number. A row is a period. A column is a group.
Group 1 is the alkali metals. Group 2 is the alkaline earth metals. Group 17 is the halogens. Group 18 is the noble gases.
For groups 1, 2, and 13 through 18, the valence count is the ones digit of the group number.
Metals sit left of the staircase. Nonmetals sit to the right. The staircase metalloids used here are B, Si, Ge, As, Sb, and Te.
Groups 1 and 2 are the s block. Groups 13 through 18 are the p block. The d block is the transition metals. The f block is the two rows drawn below the table.

worked_example.q: What is the group number of the halogens? Type the number only.
steps: The halogens are the column just left of the noble gases.

similar_problem.q: What is the group number of the noble gases? Type the number only.
similar_problem.hint: The noble gases are the last column on the right of the main table.

problems.q: What is the group number of the alkali metals? Type the number only.
problems.why: The alkali metals are the first column. That is group 1.
hints: Alkali metals have one valence electron and sit in the leftmost column.

problems.q: Which element is the halogen in period 3? Write the element symbol with a capital letter, like He.
problems.why: Period 3 runs from Na to Ar. The halogen column is group 17, which meets period 3 at Cl.
hints: Find period 3, then move to the column just left of the noble gases.

problems.q: Which element is the noble gas in period 2? Write the element symbol with a capital letter, like He.
problems.why: Period 2 ends at the group 18 element Ne.
hints: Period 2 is the Li-to-Ne row. Pick the last element in that row.

problems.q: How many valence electrons does an atom in group 16 have? Type the number only.
problems.why: The ones digit of 16 is 6, and group 16 is a main group, so there are 6 valence electrons.
hints: Use the ones digit of the group number for groups 13 through 18.

problems.q: Which element is in period 4 and group 2? Write the element symbol with a capital letter, like He.
problems.why: Period 4 starts at K. Group 2 in that period is Ca.
hints: Group 2 is the alkaline earth column. Go down to the fourth period.

problems.q: Is silicon a metal, a metalloid, or a nonmetal? Type one word.
problems.why: Silicon sits on the staircase, so it is a metalloid.
hints: Si is one of B, Si, Ge, As, Sb, and Te.

problems.q: What charge does a group 2 ion usually have? Type the charge like 2+ or 2-.
problems.why: Group 2 atoms lose two valence electrons. The ion is 2+.
hints: The ones digit is 2, and a metal loses those electrons.

problems.q: What charge does a group 16 ion usually have? Type the charge like 2+ or 2-.
problems.why: Group 16 atoms gain two electrons to finish the p subshell. The ion is 2-.
hints: Group 16 is two short of a full octet. The charge is negative.

problems.q: Which block is iron in: s, p, d, or f? Type one letter.
problems.why: Iron is a transition metal. Its last electrons enter 3d, so it is in the d block.
hints: The middle block of the table is the d block. Iron sits there.

problems.q: Is titanium a main-group element or a transition element? Type main-group or transition.
problems.why: Titanium is in the d block, so it is a transition element.
hints: Ti is in the middle block, not in groups 1, 2, or 13 through 18.

problems.q: What is the family name of group 17? Type one plural word.
hints: This is the column of F, Cl, Br, and I.

problems.q: What is the atomic number of the element in period 4 and group 15? Type the number only.
problems.why: Period 4 group 15 is arsenic, and arsenic is atomic number 33.
hints: Count across period 4 to group 15. The d block fills Z = 21 through 30 before the p block.

problems.q: What is the valence configuration shared by group 1? Use n for the period and type the s count after it.
problems.why: Every alkali metal ends in one s electron in its highest shell: ns1.
hints: Group 1 has one valence electron in an s orbital. Use n for the period.

problems.q: How many elements are in period 3? Type the number only.
problems.why: Period 3 is Na through Ar and has no d block yet. That is 8 elements.
hints: Count from sodium through argon. Do not include the transition metals.
